bio: Sister to Nüman in Kaunas, the name of this restaurant means ‘river’ in Norwegian, with the language being a clue both to the design of the room and the style of the food here. The traditional creamwashed façade of the heritage building is certainly in complete contrast to the sleek interior, which is an elegant space with a design-led style. The menu delivers a good range of creative, pared-back dishes with bold flavours, a blend of textures and eye-catching presentation, with sharing dishes for two also a feature. In summer, head for the rear terrace....
